newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan may cancel Sep naphtha buy tender - official.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan may cancel Sep naphtha buy tender - official.

text.p: Taiwan's state oil company, the Chinese Petroleum Corporation (CPC), might cancel its tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of naphtha for September 21-31 delivery due to current high prices, an official said on Tuesday.
The tender, which closed on Monday, sought offers on a fixed basis.
"There were not too many offers," the official said. "Offers were very high ... more than $200 per tonne."
He said CPC would make a decision by late Tuesday afternoon.
Asian naphtha prices have hit record highs on the back of crude hikes following mounting tension in Iraq.
